mapper.select: /* com.heeji.picket.mapper.ShowReviewsMapper.list */ SELECT SR.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId , SR.SHOW_ID AS showId , SR.CONTENT AS content , SR.INSERT_DATE AS insertDate , SR.INSERT_ID AS insertId , SR.UPDATE_DATE AS updateDate , U.NAME AS userName FROM SHOW_REVIEWS SR LEFT JOIN USER U ON SR.INSERT_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND SR.SHOW_ID = #{showId} ORDER BY SR.REVIEW_ID DESC
